Shanghai/Ningbo.note: Terminals at Waigaoqiao, Yangshan and Ningbo-Zhoushan have been fully open since 10-11 Aug, so this is backlog, not closure. The queue still is not clearing: Linerlytica's last published snapshot (16 Aug) shows 1.89m TEU at anchorage against 0.55m on 8 Aug, and the final five snapshots (1.72m, 1.76m, 1.89m, 1.87m, 1.89m) are flat rather than falling. Queue-to-berth ratio 3.25, by far the worst of the 18 tracked ports. Linerlytica has published nothing since 16 Aug, so the congestion figures here are five days old. Berth-wait figures remain SEKO's 12 Aug numbers (Shanghai 4-7 days, Ningbo 3-5 days); nobody has published newer ones. Kuehne+Nagel (18 Aug) still reports vessel backlogs, elevated yard utilisation and carriers omitting port calls.

Busan.note: Operations are normal — this is a forecast watch, not a disruption. Saudel is near the Marianas at 13.5N 149.6E and JMA forecasts it to reach typhoon strength within 24 hours and track north-northwest; the end of the 117-hour forecast track sits 964 km from Busan and still closing, so it falls outside the 600 km threat threshold for now. Korean outlets reported on 19 Aug that the storm may approach Korea after passing Okinawa. Kuehne+Nagel (18 Aug) separately puts Busan's 7-day average vessel wait at 1.38 days with laden yard utilisation above 100% at BNCT, so there is little slack if the track verifies.

remarks: STS Saudel (TC2621) is the only active tropical cyclone in the JMA feed. No analysis or forecast point comes within 600 km of any tracked port, so no threats are recorded. Closest forecast approaches at +117h: Shanghai/Ningbo 941 km, Busan 964 km.

Saudel strengthened from TS to STS since the last run and JMA forecasts typhoon strength within 24 hours. Track guidance points at Okinawa early next week with onward options toward Korea or Zhejiang — worth re-checking daily rather than acting on now.

No port closures, suspensions or emergency stoppages found at any of the 18 tracked ports. German ports (Bremerhaven, Hamburg, Wilhelmshaven) had a 24-hour ver.di warning strike ending 19 Aug, but none of those are tracked here.
Shanghai/Ningbo remains the single real problem: reopened 10-11 Aug but the anchorage queue has been flat near 1.9m TEU for five straight snapshots rather than draining.
Data staleness warning: Linerlytica's last publish date is 16 Aug and SEKO's last update is 12 Aug. Nothing on this page is fresher than five days old except the JMA cyclone feed.
